description: The dashboard is the app's one window and calls every host command: it reads the host mode and chooses it on first launch, opens its session with the local engine, and uses the local shoutout queue. In companion mode it opens the system browser for Twitch sign-in, makes this computer the signed-in instance's companion, reports the relay in its status bar, and manages this computer's local connections. It reads the app's link and update state and installs a ready update. It has the host open links that leave the app in the system browser, which opens only web pages. The host asks the streamer itself before accepting a typed address or sending a password. Beyond listening for their events, nothing from Tauri's core or its plugins.
